title: Understanding AL Development: The Type Helper Code Unit
summary: The Type Helper code unit is a utility in Business Central's System.Reflection namespace containing 74 procedures for data formatting, localization, type conversion, and math functions commonly used in API handling and advanced AL development scenarios.
key_points: Helper codeunits package reusable logic such as formatting, validation and calculations so the main business logic stays simple
Type Helper sits in the System.Reflection namespace and has 74 active procedures plus 2 obsolete ones
It covers evaluation of values, date and time formatting by culture, timezone and UTC handling, and option and field helpers
It also covers URL, HTML and JavaScript encoding, bitwise and math helpers, amount format strings, TextDistance and SortRecordRef
The author compares it to .NET Reflection helpers and says it is useful for API handling
